'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Young man, are you busy at the moment? An interested party from abroad, from behind the barricades, took an interest in a big batch of valuable medical equipment. I think they will find a better use if, instead of the scum here, you understand me. I would be extremely grateful if you could find the required tools for me. Here, take this. This is the list containing all the needed tools.}}

==Requirements== 
* Must be level 38 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 3 [[Portable defibrillator]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 3 [[Ophthalmoscope]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 20 [[Pile of meds|Piles of meds]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 10 [[Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins|Bottles of OLOLO Multivitamins]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the 3 [[Ophthalmoscope|ophthalmoscopes]]
* Hand over the 3 [[Portable defibrillator|defibrillators]]
* Hand over the 2 [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator|LEDX]]
* Hand over the 20 [[Pile of meds|Piles of meds]]
* Hand over the 10 [[Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins|multivitamins]]

==Rewards==
* +34,000 [[EXP]]
* 1× [[Medicine case]]
* +4 [[Immunity|Immunity skill]] level
* +4 [[Vitality|Vitality skill]] level
* +4 [[Surgery|Surgery skill]] level 
* Unlocks craft for [[ETG-change regenerative stimulant injector]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Medstation level 2]]

There are multiple ways to get the items needed. 

[[LEDX Skin Transilluminator]] can be found on [[The Lab]] in the center area and within the locked rooms you can open with [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]] and [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green)]].
On [[Shoreline]] they can spawn in the [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator#Location|Resort]] and on [[Sanitar|Sanitars]] body after killing him.
On [[Interchange]] they also have multiple [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator#Location|spawn locations]], especially in the [[ULTRA medical storage key|ULTRA medical]] store. You can also [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator#Crafting|craft]] the [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator]].<font color="red"><big>'''<nowiki>*</nowiki>'''</big></font>

The [[Portable defibrillator]] can be found on [[Portable defibrillator#Location|the Lab]], [[Streets of Tarkov]], and on [[Portable defibrillator#Location|Interchange]]. You can also [[Portable defibrillator#Crafting|Craft]] the [[Portable defibrillator]]

For [[Ophthalmoscope]], [[Pile of meds]] and [[Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins]] you don't need to look for specific locations since they spawn everywhere where you can find medical items. You can also [[Pile of meds#Crafting|craft]] the [[Pile of meds]].

<font color="red"><big>'''<nowiki>*</nowiki>'''</big></font> The LEDX [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator#Crafting|craft]] requires a [[Silicon Optoelectronic Integrated Circuits textbook]]. This item cannot be purchased on flea. One can be obtained from [[Lightkeeper]]'s task [[Return the Favor]].
